sloka: प्रायेण हि नरश्रेष्ठ ज्येष्ठाः पितृषु वल्लभाः ।मातॄणाम् च कनीयांसः तस्मात् रक्षे कनीयसम् ॥१-६१-१९॥
transliteration: prāyeṇa hi naraśreṣṭha jyeṣṭhāḥ pitṛṣu vallabhāḥ ।mātṝṇām ca kanīyāṁsaḥ tasmāt rakṣe kanīyasam ॥1-61-19॥

translations.english: "O Best among men generally, the eldest sons are the favourites of their fathers, the youngest their mothers: For that reason, I shall keep my youngest son.
